title: Pentax SF10 35mm SLR Film Camera, Takumar-F 28-80mm Zoom Lens
descriptionText:
There is a visible engraving on the bottom of the camera (see photos), but this does not affect functionality.

For sale is a Pentax SF10 35mm SLR film camera with a Takumar-F 28-80mm f/3.5-4.5 zoom lens. This classic camera is a great choice for film enthusiasts and collectors alike.

Condition:
✔ Camera body – In good condition with some signs of wear. There is an engraving on the bottom (see photos), but this does not affect functionality.
✔ Lens – Clean optics, no major scratches or fungus. Focus and zoom functions work smoothly.
✔ Functionality – Powers on, shutter fires, and film advances correctly. Not film-tested, but all buttons and dials respond as expected.
✔ Accessories included – Comes with a strap, and Takumar lens cap.

Features:

Autofocus & manual focus modes
Built-in motorized film advance
LCD display and exposure settings
Sturdy build quality
